headline: Fisherman's Row and Stlican Shelf Erupt in Renewed Ground Clashes
war_summary: In the three hours since the previous dispatch, coastal fighting across Fisherman's Row has flared dramatically, logging twelve base turnovers in two hours across Black Well, Eidolo, and Dankana Post. Sharp movement has also reignited on the Stlican Shelf, where six transitions were registered between Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town amidst more than sixteen hundred fresh casualties. In Callahan's Passage and the Weathered Expanse, casualty rates accelerated sharply—exceeding thirty-eight hundred and twenty-six hundred combined losses respectively over the two-hour stretch—yielding nine further base handovers between them. Mooring County, previously held firm, logged three quick ownership shifts at Wiccwalk and the Wind Hills despite remaining entirely under Warden control. Meanwhile, skirmishing around Stema Landing produced two late transitions, leaving one position in no-man's-land. By contrast, the ground contest in Nevish Line and Palantine Berm has quieted without fresh territory trading hands, and Linn of Mercy experienced a sudden surge in casualties without yielding positional change.
